# Everything the player sees and hears is generated by code

Court Feel ships no third-party art or audio files. The athlete is a
procedurally built skinned mesh with code-authored poses and IK, the textures
are drawn by code and the sounds are synthesised. No free character pack has
volleyball motions (an approach, an arm swing, a block), and the asset sites
tried at the start could not be reached from the build environment, so
authoring the motion in code was the way to get it right.

## Consequences

An asset can still be added. It needs an MIT-compatible licence, an entry in
[CREDITS.md](../../CREDITS.md) and a yes from the maintainer first.
